verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 47.22
verses.english: Linked Discourses 47.22

verses.pali: 3. Sīlaṭṭhitivagga
verses.english: 3. Ethics and Duration

verses.pali: Ciraṭṭhitisutta
verses.english: Long Lasting

verses.pali: Taṁyeva nidānaṁ.
verses.english: The same setting.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Venerable Bhadda said to Venerable Ānanda:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti?
verses.english: “What is the cause, Reverend Ānanda, what is the reason why the true teaching does not last long after the final quenching of the Realized One?

verses.pali: Ko panāvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotī”ti?
verses.english: What is the cause, what is the reason why the true teaching does last long after the final quenching of the Realized One?”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, āvuso bhadda.
verses.english: “Good, good, Reverend Bhadda!

verses.pali: Bhaddako kho te, āvuso bhadda, ummaṅgo, bhaddakaṁ paṭibhānaṁ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
verses.english: Your approach and eloquence are excellent, and it’s a good question.

verses.pali: Evañhi tvaṁ, āvuso bhadda, pucchasi:
verses.english: For you asked:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti?
verses.english: ‘What is the cause, Reverend Ānanda, what is the reason why the true teaching does not last long after the final quenching of the Realized One?

verses.pali: Ko panāvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotī’”ti?
verses.english: What is the cause, what is the reason why the true teaching does last long after the final quenching of the Realized One?’”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti.
verses.english: “Yes, reverend.”

verses.pali: “Catunnaṁ kho, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
verses.english: “It’s because of not developing and cultivating the four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching doesn’t last long after the final quenching of the Realized One.

verses.pali: Catunnañca kho, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
verses.english: It’s because of developing and cultivating the four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching does last long after the final quenching of the Realized One.

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ catunnaṁ?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant meditates by observing an aspect of the body—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: vedanāsu …pe…
verses.english: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …

verses.pali: citte …pe…
verses.english: mind …

verses.pali: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ.
verses.english: principles—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, āvuso, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
verses.english: It’s because of not developing and cultivating these four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching doesn’t last long after the final quenching of the Realized One.

verses.pali: Imesañca kho, āvuso, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotī”ti.
verses.english: It’s because of developing and cultivating these four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching does last long after the final quenching of the Realized One.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
